environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running Amazon Linux 2, deployed in VPC subnet with no network ACL restrictions on internal traffic. The payment processor runs as a systemd service under root. Other services in the same instance can send signals and connect to port 8080. No service mesh or network policy enforcement. Instance security group allows all internal VPC traffic (10.0.0.0/8). The processor.conf file is writable by the application user. A cron job sends SIGUSR1 every 5 minutes for config rotation.
